description: Maryland Outage Data (Zip Code) is a dataset listed in Open Energy Hub (ORNL), an energy-sector data hub, published or maintained by Oak Ridge National Laboratory for the U.S. DOE Office of Electricity. Contains aggregated power outage data by Zip Code. Limited historical record inventory. Designed for and consumed by the Maryland Emergency Management Agency (MEMA) Power Outage web application. The Maryland Department of Information Technology updates this dataset approximately every 15 minutes. Coverage: the United States. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Electricity, Outage. Its keywords are power outage, distribution grid outages, electric power failures. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is No license, or terms of use, asserted by data producer for this dataset was found.. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oeh-open-data-portal.
